body:
Pass-the-ball: real kick logic in MatchSim match loop. Closes Slice-7 static-ball regression (blueprint patch 8e2dc1b flagged it; this commit fixes the underlying bug). Phase-3 minimum: player in possession of stationary-or-slow ball emits a kick at the FORWARD-MOST eligible teammate (pass-to-teammate); long-ball-to-goal fallback if no eligible teammate. Pressing-team players unchanged. New motion makes match look like football naturally.

acceptance:
- PlayerCommand extends with optional KickIntent { Vector3Fixed Velocity, Vector3Fixed Spin }. Spin=Zero for Phase-3. Backward-compat: existing no-kick callers keep working.
- BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick emits KickIntent on carrier when: (a) own team has possession (closest-to-ball own player), (b) ball velocity < CarrierKickGate (default 2 m/s), (c) carrier within possession radius. Aim: forward-most teammate in opponent half (or further-forward than carrier if already in opponent half), distance MinPass..MaxPass (8..35m). Fallback: opponent goal centre at LongBallSpeed (18 m/s). Kick velocity = direction.Normalize() * PassSpeed (14 m/s default).
- MatchSimulationRunner applies KickIntent to Ball.Velocity AFTER PlayerActuator.Step × 22, BEFORE BallPhysics.Step. Home-then-Away order; last-writer-wins on same-tick double-emit. Documented in comments.
- One kick max per side per tick (BT logic + kick gate enforce it naturally).
- NEW: Match_PassTheBall_60Seconds_BallMovesSubstantially — runs smoke fixture 3600 ticks, asserts accumulated ball travel >= 30m. Fails loud if ball glued to centre.
- NEW: Match_PassTheBall_KickIntentDeterministic — byte-identical canonical hashes across two runs.
- 644 MatchSim tests stay green EXCEPT pinned 60-tick hash intentionally re-baselined. Update MatchDeterminismTests.cs literal + MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xdeadbeefdeadbeef.json expected. Preserve prior hash in comment.
- fw verify GREEN.
- Natural-play L2 evidence per /duo-implement Step 4.1: ≥1 docs/screenshots/passtheball-natural-tick-NNNN.png from a 60s smoke-fixture Play with driveSim=true, NO synthetic injection. Plain-English observation in commit-proposal: ball motion + throw-ins + players dispersing.

depends_on: Slice 7 (950f906) + Step-A blueprint patch (8e2dc1b) — this commit is the FIRST under the new natural-play L2 gate.

LoC ~400-600. Reviewer-gate-before-commit per ADR-0012 §C2. Codex MUST counter if commit-proposal lacks natural-play L2 evidence per Step 4.1.

commit-proposal: pass-the-ball v1 — the match actually plays football now. 647/647 MatchSim green (+3 new); pinned 60-tick hash UNCHANGED (kicks fire after tick ~150); fw verify GREEN.

Files (~590 LoC):
- MatchSim/Sim/KickIntent.cs NEW readonly struct {Velocity, Spin}; Magnus-stub policy honored (Spin=Zero @Phase3); Ground() factory.
- MatchSim/Sim/PlayerCommand.cs +30 LoC: nullable KickIntent? Kick + WithKick() factory + GetHashCode/Equals/ToString. Backward-compat byte-identical for no-kick callers.
- MatchSim/Sim/BehaviorTreeRunner.cs +150 LoC: pass-the-ball coefficients (CarrierKickGate=2 m/s, MinPass=8m, MaxPass=35m, PassSpeed=14 m/s, LongBallSpeed=18 m/s) + ChoosePassKick() sqrt-free forward-most teammate selection + long-ball-to-goal fallback. Carrier emits kick only when team in possession + within Kinematics.Radius (0.5m) + ball velocity < 2 m/s. One kick max per side per tick.
- MatchSim/Sim/MatchSimulationRunner.cs +30 LoC: ApplyTeamKickIfAny() between PlayerActuator.Step×22 and BallPhysics.Step; home-then-away; last-writer-wins on (rare) same-tick double-emit.
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/PassTheBallTests.cs NEW ~170 LoC; 3 tests: 60-second playback ball-moves-substantially (>=30m accumulated travel + at least 1 high-velocity tick); two-run byte-identical canonical state at 600 ticks; pinned hash sha256:c5ab9e5265724dc79ef5bf038123fbaadb686c3e9d35e79f682ee16882fed1d2 @600 ticks.

Verification: 647/647 MatchSim; 60-tick pinned hash UNCHANGED; fw verify GREEN; banned-terms clean; shader-audit clean; plugin DLL republished.

NATURAL-PLAY L2 EVIDENCE per /duo-implement Step 4.1 (NEW gate; this commit is the first to clear):

Loaded DotsViewer.unity, pressed Play, watched 65s natural play, driveSim=true, NO `execute_code` injection. What I SAW:
- Tick ~150: First presser reaches ball, gains possession, kicks. Ball ROLLS toward Home goal.
- Tick 793 (passtheball-natural-tick-0793-ball-moving-left.png): Ball at (-6.56, 0, 0.13), velocity (1.12, 0, 0); players spread across mid-right reaching for it; diagonal-attack-lane camera heuristic triggered (frame shifted). Score 0-0.
- Tick 2119: GOAL (Home scores, ball crosses +X). KeyEvent fires; respawn at centre.
- Tick 2374 (passtheball-natural-tick-2374-score-1-0.png): Score 1-0; commentary overlay reads "Gets onto the end of it — finds the back of the net." — Slice-6 template fired NATURALLY from goal event.
- Tick 2798: GOAL (Away equalises).
- Tick 3893 (passtheball-natural-tick-3893-score-1-1.png): Score 1-1; both teams contesting ball at left side.

Real football. Goals happen organically. Commentary fires. Slice 7 visual surfaces (pressure-tint / motion-line / selection-ring) will NOW have a chance to fire naturally because the gates depend on a moving ball + signature triggers (validating signature firing in natural play is the next polish-pass audit item — not blocking this commit).

Caveats:
- Scoreboard minute counter shows "0'" in captures — at tick 2374 = 39s = 0 minutes; that's correct math. Visual just looks unhelpful at the smoke timescale; Phase-3 polish to revisit.
- I have not validated signature events fire in natural play. The ball moves; whether the right players have possession at high-stakes moments for signature triggers is empirical.

fix-budget: 0 of 2 used. Awaiting Codex ack.

ack — pass-the-ball v1 approved. I reviewed the MatchSim loop and confirmed KickIntent is emitted only by the in-possession carrier under the slow-ball/on-ball gate, then applied home-then-away after PlayerActuator and before BallPhysics. I also verified the new 600/3600-tick tests, natural-play screenshot artifacts, plugin-drop verification, and scripts/fw verify locally: 647/647 MatchSim green. I am not treating the unchanged 60-tick corpus hash as a blocker because the new behavior starts after the existing 60-tick smoke window; the new 600-tick pin covers the kick-enabled window. No blocking findings.
